claims: Kyle Sterbinsky is the current caddie for PGA Tour golfer Cameron Young.
Kyle Sterbinsky and Cameron Young were teammates on the Wake Forest men's golf team.
Kyle Sterbinsky joined Cameron Young's team during the 2025 season after working on mini-tours.
The partnership between Kyle Sterbinsky and Cameron Young began as a temporary arrangement at the 2025 Truist Championship.
The partnership began after Cameron Young needed a change due to poor performance.
Cameron Young won his first PGA Tour title at the 2025 Wyndham Championship.
Paul Tesori caddied for Cameron Young in 2023 for a short period.
Cameron Young stated that Kyle Sterbinsky's green-reading abilities helped improve his performance significantly
